en: OTA updates the app and data packs
Language pack changes no longer need a full install
Older packs load; new keys fall back to English
Home offers a retry when packs fall back
Check updates can install packs only
UI fixes for prompts, icons and sleep
Run Check updates once after upgrading
zh: OTA 同时更新固件与数据包
语言包键数变化不再要求完整安装
旧语言包自动兼容，新键回退英文
数据包失败后首页提示重试
检查更新可只更新语言与资源包
提示、图标与睡眠画面修正
升级后请检查更新一次
